name: The Logan Whaley Band
reviewNotes:
Added automatically from The Villager (Farmingdale) - live music calendar. Check the name and add a website or social page.

Directory research 2026-10-04: The band now calls itself 'Whaley' (renamed from The Logan Whaley Band), but venues such as The Villager still use the old name; consider adding 'Whaley' as an alias. The site's tour page was empty and its home page still showed an old date, so no booking contact was found (no email, phone or booking form). No real logo on the site (only album-cover art), so none recorded. All three photos are black-and-white live shots from the band's bio page.
description: Long Island band led by singer and guitarist Logan Whaley, now also billed as 'Whaley'. It mixes funk, rock, R&B, reggae and jazz in danceable sets of original songs (debut album 'Funky Tonight') and covers.
